scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @manhunt/server" "npm run dev -w @manhunt/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @manhunt/web && npm run typecheck -w @manhunt/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @manhunt/web && npm run typecheck -w @manhunt/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @manhunt/web && npm run test -w @manhunt/server
